name: Healthy Dinner Basics
instructions: Fill half your dinner plate with vegetables first, then add protein and a smaller portion of starch -- an easy visual rule that needs no counting.
Cook extra portions at dinner intentionally; tonight's dinner is often tomorrow's easiest lunch.
Season with herbs, spices, and citrus instead of leaning on heavy sauces for flavor.
Watch today's video for five healthy dinner ideas for busy weeknights.
